description: Move every AI feature to OpenRouter through @openrouter/sdk: one model variable for each role with no default model, fail-closed behavior, usage logging without prompt text, no PII in prompts, a structured-output helper for the two BM2 evaluation features (the teacher summary reuses the lesson-level ai-interpretation prompt without the student name), and removal of the OpenAI paths. Depends on vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114.
